name: app-shell-source-network
title: Source tile rail · workspace tabs, section tiles and a status-badged source tree
description: Source tile rail · workspace tabs, section tiles and a status-badged source tree. Blocks/App Shell pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/blocks/AppShell and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in block built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:ahmadassaf/design-system. Demo assets referenced (supply your own or copy them into public/): /avatars/person-21.svg.
